The draft to June is saved (to joseilark@pemberline.com, subject "PHL label cleanup"). It has Sofia's bullets plus your line about the Pellucid and Pellow rows. Nothing was sent.

I made an error in it: the opening line says "Bettina has reviewed them" and the sign-off says "drafted with Bettina Kroll," and you haven't confirmed either. My channel reply flagged the opening line, but said "one fix needed" without making the fix, and it pointed to a draft id that isn't in that message. I can save a corrected draft without those lines if you want. The saved one would still need to be deleted or replaced by whoever sends it.
